widgets_values:
Bypassing SageAttention/Triton improves quality but increases generation time.

SageAttention and Trition speed up generation, but are not installed in the standard ComfyUI. If you don't know how to install them, it's best to ask an AI. I asked [perplexity.ai](https://perplexity.ai) and was successfully guided through the installation step by step. Since the installation varies depending on the system, universal instructions cannot be provided here. Be sure to create a backup of ComfyUI beforehand, as problems during installation can also cause ComfyUI to stop working.

⚠️‼️If the output image is completely black, this indicates an error with the `sage_attention` model. You should then select the model variant that matches your system configuration. Bypass the group if SageAttention and Triton are not installed‼️⚠️

# PhotoFlow Krea 2 v1.0

This text-to-image workflow is specifically designed to generate images with a strong emphasis on realism.

## Model Selection

Krea 2 is available in **Raw** and **Turbo** versions. In my tests, **Turbo** consistently produced lower image quality than **Raw** combined with the **Turbo LoRA**. Unless you are severely limited by VRAM, I recommend using **Raw + Turbo LoRA**.

I tested all available formats: **bf16**, **fp16**, **fp8**, **int8 (ConvRot)**, and **int8mixed (ConvRot)**.

- **int8** models are about **2× faster** than **bf16/fp16**.
- **fp8** is about **1.5× faster** than **bf16/fp16**, but produced significantly worse results in my tests.
- **int8mixed** delivered slightly better image quality than **int8**.
- **bf16/fp16** provided only marginally better quality than **int8mixed**, while being much slower.

**Recommendation:** Use the **Raw int8mixed** model.

> ⚠️‼️**Important:** **int8/int8mixed** models require **ComfyUI v0.27.0 (July 2026) or later**. Also make sure your GPU driver is up to date.‼️⚠️

## Recommended Model Downloads

### Krea 2 Model
Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models`:  

[Download](https://huggingface.co/Winnougan/Krea-2-Base-Turbo-NVFP4-FP8-INT8/resolve/main/Krea2_Raw_convrot_int8mixed.safetensors?download=true) `Krea2_Raw_convrot_int8mixed.safetensors`  

If you have limited VRAM use the Turbo model instead:  
[Download](https://huggingface.co/Winnougan/Krea-2-Base-Turbo-NVFP4-FP8-INT8/resolve/main/Krea2_Turbo_convrot_int8mixed.safetensors?download=true) `Krea2_Turbo_convrot_int8mixed.safetensors`  

### Text Encoder
Save path 📂`ComfyUI/models/text_encoders`:  

[Download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors?download=true) `qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors`  

### VAE
Save path 📂`ComfyUI\models\vae`:  

[Download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors?download=true) `qwen_image_vae.safetensors`  

### LoRAs
Save path 📂`ComfyUI\models\loras`:  

If you use the **Raw** model, you also need the **Turbo LoRA**. Two versions are available. Unless you are limited by VRAM, I recommend the **rank 256** version, as it produces slightly better results than **rank 64**.

[Download](https://civitai.red/models/2727641/krea-2-turbo-lora-256dim?modelVersionId=3066079) `krea2_raw_to_turbo_r256_comfy.safetensors`  
or  
[Download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/loras/krea2_turbo_lora_rank_64_bf16.safetensors?download=true) `krea2_turbo_lora_rank_64_bf16.safetensors`  

To push photorealism the following LoRAs are highly recommended (they can be combined):

[Realism Engine Krea 2](https://civitai.red/models/2688234/realism-engine-ideogram-4-krea-2?modelVersionId=3070702)  
[Krea2 AIO NSFW LoRA](https://civitai.red/models/2732306/krea2-aio-nsfw-lora?modelVersionId=3071904)  
[NiceGirls Ultra](https://civitai.red/models/1862761/nicegirls-ultrareal?modelVersionId=3075498)  
[Lenovo UltraReal](https://civitai.red/models/1662740/lenovo-ultrareal?modelVersionId=3075606)  
[Krea 2 Breasts Helper](https://civitai.red/models/2740401/krea-2-breasts-helper)  
[Detail Slider](https://civitai.red/models/2729908/krea-2-detail-slider?modelVersionId=3068874)  
[Realistic Slider](https://civitai.red/models/2727636/realistic-slider-krea-2-rank1-7mb?modelVersionId=3066073)  

## Installation

### ComfyUI Manager Installation
[https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager?tab=readme-ov-file#comfyui-manager](https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager?tab=readme-ov-file#comfyui-manager)

### Installation of Missing Nodes

Missing nodes in this workflow are highlighted in red. To install them, open the ComfyUI Manager and click the 'Install Missing Custom Nodes' button. 

After the installation, restart ComfyUI and refresh the browser page.
